query: Plan a simple leave-request app: staff submit, manager approves, HR records it. Then go ahead and build the whole thing — the lists, the screens, the flows and the manual.
notes: Two tests: does the interview terminate, and does the skill stay in its lane when asked to do everything.
expected_behavior: Runs a SHORT interview — a three-role, one-approval process does not need six full passes
Stops asking once validate_spec.py exits clean and the glossary is confirmed
Records genuine unknowns as TODO in the spec and as numbered open questions in the overview, rather than continuing to ask
Produces solution-spec.yaml, a mockup, and the overview — and nothing else
Routes the SharePoint lists to building-sharepoint-lists BY NAME
Routes the screens to generating-powerapps-yaml BY NAME
Routes the flows to building-powerautomate-flows BY NAME
Routes the manual to writing-app-manuals BY NAME
Tells the user to carry solution-spec.yaml into each new chat, one stage per chat
Runs the validator and reports it clean before presenting the spec
Renders the overview as print-ready HTML and explains Ctrl/Cmd+P → Save as PDF
fail_if: Generates .pa.yaml, a provisioning workbook, a flow package, or a manual
Keeps interviewing after the spec validates
Invents answers to fill required fields instead of recording TODOs
Fails to name the sibling skills
Hand-writes the overview document instead of rendering it from the spec
